content: Salo bollanne sa7a bolla dizay wuri hayssaththo oosetti polettides.
Xoossi ba ooththida ooso usuppunththa gallas polidi ba ooththida ooso ubbaafe laappunththa gallas shempides.
Qasse Xoossi laappunththa gallassaa anjjidessinne dumma gallas ooththides; ays giikko Xoossi ba ooththiza ooso wursidi shempiday he gallassanna.
Saloynne sa7ay medhettiday hessa malanna. Edene Gannate GODAY sa7anne salo medhdhida wode,
sa7a bollan maatay, miththi, ay miishshika mokkibeenna; ays giikko GODAY ira bukisibeenna; qasse biitta ooththiza asikka medhettibeenna.
Gidikkoka haaththi biittafe pude maacotti kezidi biitta ubbaa irxxisees.
Hessafe guye GODAY biittafe issi as medhdhidi iza siidhen de7o shemppo punnin addezi shemppora dizaade gidides.
Kase GODAY arshey mokkiza baggara Edene geetettizason lo7oso giigsidi ba medhdhida addeza heen woththides.
GODAY xeellanaas lo7iza, maanaaska mal7iza dumma dumma qommo mith biittafe mokisides; Edene giddon de7o immiza miththi dees; hessaththoka lo7onne iita erisiza mith woththides.
Gannate ushshiza shaafa haaththi Edeneppe goggees. Edeneppe kezidaappe guye, oyddu shaafa gidi shaakettees.
Koyro shaafaa sunththi Pisoone; Pisooney worqqay diza Hawila geetettiza biittaa yuusho ubbaan goggees.
He biittaa worqqay geeshsha worqqa; qasse al7o shittoynne keehi lo7iza shuchchi heen dees.
Nam7anththo shaafaa sunththi Giyoone; Giyooney Tophphiya
biitta yuusho ubbaan goggees.
Heedzdzanththo shaafaa sunththi Xegroose; Xegroosey Asooreppe arshey mokkiza baggara goggees; qasse oydanththo shaafay Efiraaxise geetettees.
Addezi Edenen ooththana malanne naagana mala GODAA Xoossay iza efi woththides.
Histtidi GODAA Xoossay addeza, «Edene miththa teera ubbaafe neni maana giikko ma;
gido attiin lo7onne iita erisiza miththay teerappe mooppa; ays giikko neni izippe mida gallas tumu hayqqana» gi azazides.
Hessafe guye GODAA Xoossay, «Addezi barkka dizayssi lo7o deenna; tani izas injjetiza maado as medhdhana» gides.

GODAA Xoossay kase meheta do7ata salo kafota ubbaa biittafe medhdhides; qasse addezi istta ay giidi sunththanakko siyanaas izakko ehiin addezi shemppora diza medheteththata ubbaa sunththida sunththay isttas sunth gidi attides.
Hessaththo addezi meheta, salo kafotanne, do7ata ubbaa sunththides; gido attiin Addaames injjetiza maado asi beettibeenna.
Hessa gishshas GODAA Xoossay addeza dhisko dhiskisidi, izi dhiskon dishin iza mille meqeththatappe issaa ekkidi he sohozan asho kunththides.
GODAA Xoossay addezappe ekkida meqeththaa maccas medhdhidi izo addezakko ehides.
Ehiin addezi, «Hekko! Ha meqeththaya ta meqeththafe, ha ashoyakka ta ashoppe ekettidaaro; izakka attumasappe ekettida gishshas, maccas geetettu» gides.
Hessa gishshas asi ba aawaanne ba aayo aggees; ba machcheyra issife dees; istti nam7ay issi asho.
Addezinne iza machcheya nam7ayka paxa kallo deettes; gido attiin issay issaas yeellati erettenna.

footnotes.text: As guussi Ibraaweta qaalan, «Addaame» geetettees; «Addaame» guussi, «Biitta» geetettees; he nam7u qaalati issoy issaa misateettes.
Tophphiya: Tophphiya gizayssa Ibraawe maxaafay Kuush gees.
Adde guussi Ibraaweta qaalan «Ish» geetettees; «Maccas» guussi, «Isha» geetettees; he nam7u qaalati issoy issaa misateettes.
